historical_references.reference: Al-Hathim ibn Harith al-Tamimi was a poet and companion of the Prophet Muhammad. He was known for his unique poetic style and his strong faith. Al-Hathim migrated to Medina with his family during the early stages of Islam and became one of the Prophet's closest allies. He is reported to have participated in several battles with the Prophet, including the Battle of Hunayn and the Battle of Tabuk.

Al-Hathim ibn Ali was a notable Sufi scholar and the author of 'Asrar al-Arifeen' (The Secrets of the Gnostics). He lived during the 13th century and was a disciple of Ibn al-Arabi, the renowned Sufi philosopher. Al-Hathim is known for his mystical interpretations of Islamic texts and his emphasis on the inner experience of faith.
